mathematics.assertion_tested: Vary all ten symmetric inverse-metric components of sqrt(-g)[P(X,tau)-V(tau)+sW(Y,tau)], verify stress and invariant transverse pressure, then evaluate frozen action stress at all five positive recorded L192 transverse and longitudinal roots for reference and physical Q.
mathematics.coefficient_domain: Exact SymPy expressions plus IEEE754 float64 numerical evaluations
mathematics.conventions: Signature(-+++), X=-g^ab chi_a chi_b, s=sqrt(-g^ab tau_a tau_b), Y=-X+(g^ab tau_a chi_b)^2/s^2, tau=s0*t,chi=Q*t+b*x,Y=b^2. Gamma=0. P baseline always uses frozen qbar; physical Q never replaces it. No root refit.
inputs: Frozen constitutive.py coefficient IVP and action jets
non_claims: Not an on-shell gamma0 cosmological or anisotropic solution.
Not the full Einstein/cubic principal reduction, nonlinear attractor, or observational theory.
